title: Advanced SELECT [JOIN (FULL OUTER)]
description:
## FULL OUTER JOIN
You know LEFT JOIN keeps all rows from the left table, and RIGHT JOIN keeps all from the right. FULL OUTER JOIN keeps ALL rows from BOTH tables.

```
INNER JOIN:       Only matches
LEFT JOIN:        All left + matches
RIGHT JOIN:       All right + matches
FULL OUTER JOIN:  Everything from both
```

```sql
SELECT users.name, invoices.amount
FROM users
FULL OUTER JOIN invoices
    ON users.id = invoices.user_id;
```
Users with no invoices still show up. Invoices with no matching user still show up. Nobody gets left behind.

BWS has servers and tickets. Some servers have no tickets, some tickets reference deleted servers. Show all servers and all tickets using a FULL OUTER JOIN. Select server name and ticket title.
